name: feedback-server
description: Agent-first management for FeedbackServer products, public feedback, waitlists, activity, roadmaps, releases, attachments, Bark, Webhooks, and audit records.

interface.shortDescription: Manage app feedback without an admin GUI.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to FeedbackServer through a shared local MCP process with scoped administrator API tokens, waitlist management, and risk-based confirmations.
defaultPrompt: Set up FeedbackServer for my app and guide me through the next step.
List my apps and summarize unresolved feedback.
Draft a reply to recent feedback and show me before sending.
Review roadmap items and draft the next changelog.

feedback-server.title: Feedback Server
feedback-server.description: Manage FeedbackServer products and feedback through a local MCP server with risk-based confirmations.
